title: Everspin Looks to Broaden MRAM Adoption with LPDDR Standard
body_markdown:
By


[Gary Hilson](https://www.eetimes.com/author/gary-hilson/)


In this EE Times article, Everspin Technologies Vice President of Corporate Strategy Steffen Hellmold speaks about a new JEDEC task group exploring an LPDDR persistent memory standard for MRAM. Hellmold, who chairs the group under JEDEC’s JC-42.6 Low Power Memories Subcommittee, explains why broader MRAM adoption will depend in part on making it easier for controller vendors to support persistent memory within newer LPDDR architectures.


The discussion looks at what would need to change in LPDDR controller implementations to support MRAM, why industry participation matters and where higher-density MRAM could fit across edge AI, industrial, automotive, enterprise storage and hyperscale data center systems. The article also connects the JEDEC work with Everspin’s broader efforts to expand MRAM use, including its recent CXL-attached DDR4 MRAM demonstration.


[Read the full article in EE Times](https://www.eetimes.com/everspin-looks-to-broaden-mram-adoption-with-lpddr-standard/)
